competitiveSet.name: Hilton Guadalajara (WTC / Expo adjacency)
competitiveSet.rationale: AAA full-service neighbour to Expo Guadalajara / World Trade Center; direct group and meetings competitor for Expo-adjacent demand.

competitiveSet.name: The Westin Guadalajara
competitiveSet.rationale: Listed ~150 m / 2 mins from Expo on Expo Guadalajara allied hotels; upscale Expo-adjacent lodging competitor.

competitiveSet.name: Real Inn Expo (Camino Real Expo corridor)
competitiveSet.rationale: Expo Guadalajara allied hotel ~150 m; direct corridor competitor for exhibitor/attendee lodging.

competitiveSet.name: Barceló Guadalajara
competitiveSet.rationale: Large full-service property opposite Expo Guadalajara with substantial meeting inventory; competing for congress/overflow blocks.

competitiveSet.name: AC Hotel Guadalajara Expo
competitiveSet.rationale: Marriott select-service ~5 minutes from Expo; overlapping Bonvoy / Expo-corridor transient and small-group demand.

competitiveSet.name: Crowne Plaza Guadalajara (López Mateos / Plaza del Sol)
competitiveSet.rationale: Plaza del Sol corridor full-service alternative near Expo approach roads.

note: Competitive set is geography/positioning reference — not automatic CMI opportunity membership.
